notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers Redis install and redis.conf, redis-cli data-structure commands, RDB/AOF persistence, Sentinel, cluster mode, caching/rate-limit/pub-sub/lock patterns, a Docker Compose stack and monitoring commands.

Medium: following it has the agent install packages with sudo apt/dnf, edit /etc/redis/redis.conf and restart the service, create or rebalance a Redis cluster, run `docker compose up -d`, and pass a Redis password on the command line. Acceptable because these are the standard setup steps for the user's own Redis deployment, the password is an obvious placeholder (strong_redis_password), and the config disables dangerous commands (FLUSHALL, FLUSHDB, CONFIG, DEBUG).

Review before applying: the sample config binds 0.0.0.0 (SKILL.md:51) and the Compose file publishes 6379, 26379 and an unauthenticated redis-commander UI on 8081 using the :latest tag (SKILL.md:319-349) — restrict exposure in production; `redis-cli -a` puts the password in shell history and process lists. Related Skills (SKILL.md:402-405) link to sibling skills ../postgresql/, ../mysql/, ../mongodb/, ../database-backups/ as optional reading only.
